title: setup.step@1
description: A step setup took on this machine (#1100), from the one list of steps the first-launch screen named before the click: its step, and the agent whose settings it changed or whose history it read. `deep setup`, the first `deep` command and the app's Set up each write one per step they took. Only the core appends it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Who wrote it, from the connection; never an agent through MCP, since no deep_* tool produces this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

step.description: The step, as setup's list names it: `hooks`, `plugin` or `history`.

agent.description: The agent's ID as its facts name it, such as `claude-code` or `codex`; null for a step of no agent.
